results.question: Who's most at risk right now?
results.cypher:
MATCH (t:Team)-[n:NEAR]->(e) WHERE n.active = true
WITH t, collect({id:e.id, kind:e.kind, status:e.status, distance_m:n.distance_m, sources:n.sources}) AS near
WITH t, near, reduce(s=0, r IN near | s + CASE WHEN r.kind='hazard' AND r.status='active' THEN 50
                                            WHEN r.kind='building' AND r.status='collapsed' THEN 30
                                            WHEN r.kind='building' AND r.status='damaged' THEN 10
                                            WHEN r.kind='road' AND r.status='blocked' THEN 20
                                            WHEN r.kind='facility' AND r.status='closed' THEN 25
                                            ELSE 0 END) AS risk
WHERE risk > 0
RETURN t.id AS id, t.name AS name, risk, [r IN near WHERE r.kind='hazard' AND r.status='active'][0].id AS hazard_id, [r IN near WHERE r.kind='building' AND r.status='collapsed'][0].id AS building_id
ORDER BY risk DESC
LIMIT 1
results.answer: Rescue Team 4 is most at risk with a risk score of 130, primarily due to an active gas hazard at Hazard-gas-Sensor-Gas3 and a collapsed building at Building-14.
